name: Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks
description: In India's Uttarakhand state, high in the western Himalaya, two national parks sit about 20 km apart. The Valley of Flowers is a gentle glacial valley whose alpine meadows burst into bloom with endemic wildflowers. Nearby, Nanda Devi National Park is a rugged mountain wilderness. Snow leopards, brown bears and blue sheep roam the area, which botanists and mountaineers have praised for over a century.
